publication.evidenceLocation: GitHub v3.0.2 release, main checks and Pages deployment records
publication.boundary: This file records local acceptance; publication commit identity and live acceptance are recorded externally to avoid a self-referential commit hash.

alertCoverage.scope: Producer source-health presence; this does not establish cadence-specific observation freshness for every monitor.

coverageGaps: City and county child pages are inventoried but not yet collected by a dedicated monitor.
Harbor/County document links are bounded acquisitions; archive pagination, PDF text, recordings and calendar completeness are not established.
County Board of Supervisors, Solid Waste Management Authority, and Redwood Coast Transit Authority meeting streams need dedicated connectors.
Probe availability does not replace parser-level validation or source-health emitted by a configured monitor.

boundaries: Citation identity does not establish semantic support or factuality.
PDF extraction does not establish votes or legal effective dates.
Catalog/statewide records do not establish local regulated-record coverage.
Native temporary backend acceptance does not establish permanent deployment.
External private consumer state, scheduler installation and push display are separate acceptance.
Present source-health and recent fetch times do not establish cadence-specific observation freshness or geographic completeness for every monitor.

localLlmIntegration.scope: isolated fixture with actual local embedding/generation/vector services

geoConsumer.scope: Actual source observation loader and its real dependencies; full package initializer and analytics admission not exercised

pagesBrowser.scope: Exact full local v3.0.2 publication; whole-tree validation and nine real-browser page checks at four viewports passed.

container.scope: Native Linux GUI with an empty corpus and explicit optional-backend degradation; backend/profile acceptance is separate

authoritativeGate.scope: Frozen final runtime source with populated fresh municipal corpus in an independent checkout; optional live model behavior verified separately.

freshWeeklyRun.scope: Successful retained run and browser shutdown; whole-run interruption and wedged-browser process reaping remain separate acceptance.

workflowYaml.scope: Real YAML parsing and minimum runnable job/step shapes; hosted GitHub compilation remains external acceptance.

sitemapPortability.legacyArtifactDisposition: Explicit missing-provenance rejection; no metadata invented or rewritten.
